The days of self driving cars are upon us, but there are many things blocking the passage of laws to enable the use of self driving cars on public roads. Besides for the concerns of 'who is responsible for a death caused by a self driving car' (Which in my opinion can be solved simply by insurance... somehow ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ ) (See This article for an interesting read on this) there is still the very technical concern of self driving cars communicating with ALL of the other cars on the roads for all practical purposes. Instead of simply banning human-driven cars (Which will not be happening any time soon) companies like Google and Tesla (amongst many others) should spend their efforts on manufacturing a device that can be easily installed into cars for a relatively low price tag to enable even human-driven cars to communicate with self-driven cars (and possibly even other human-driven cars).

I firmly believe that with the level of technology we have now, a device like this can be made to be relatively inexpensive for the common person. Also once self-driving cars are legalized, transportation can become much cheaper... See this article
By the year 2020, all cars in the US should be mandated to have special sensors installed in order to enable them to communicate with self driving cars. [Read post]

If self driving cars and other smart objects become more common place it would be interesting if they didn't just self preserve or repair themselves but were also able to disassemble themselves then reassemble into other types of goods.

This is a really awesome story-

I found out last minute from the radio that KISS was going to be playing at the L.A. Forum. My girl had gone the the Lakers game and I was trying to figure out how the hell to go and who the hell to take with me.

So I called a few people and no one was available. Then my friend who was a sushi chef for Benihana's at the time, I went by his house to see if he wanted to go. No luck.

So I am like -FUCK- I have to drive all the way to the hellhole called L.A. and I have to go by myself... nice. I gassed up my car and I think I had MAYBE 50.00 in my wallet. I am like. I am fucked. No way can I pull this off with 50.00....

So I just said what the hell- I am going. I make my way through Friday night traffic. I finally get to the Forum and park. I get there early... wow! I thought I was going to be late. As soon as I pull up, I had a Camaro with T tops at the time, someone hands me a beer! I am like YES!.Thank God. Then I start walking around and people are passing me joints left and right. Now were talking. Now its going to be a concert. But all I have is 50.00.... So I am hustling for a ticket for what seemed like an eternity...

Then, this guy says, hey, I am surprising my friend with front row tickets.... he has no idea, so you can grab his ticket... I said sure. So I am partying with everyone and not spending a dime. Then someone brings everybody ACID... and I am like, ahhh... what the hell..... ITS MOTHERFUCKING KISS FOR CHRIST SAKE! I have no idea what I paid for the ticket, had decent seats, Got to see KISS with full makeup, NO IDEA how the fuck I got home....

Not too bad for making the show at the very last minute I thought! :)

Yeah, it was pretty awesome.
